_comment: Fleet vocabulary. Copy to <board repo>/fleet.config.json (or point BOARD_CONFIG at it). A missing file = built-in defaults; a broken file refuses startup.
_deploy: Deployment truth (v0.3, all optional; env vars override when set). port: the board's port, read by the server AND every client — set it once here instead of in two shells. repo: the WORK repo workers act in (worker cwd + deliverable-gate anchor); omit for a standalone board. gated_subtree: the source gate's subtree — '.' = the whole tree, the honest anchor for a standalone clone; with it here, no shell ever needs to export BOARD_GATED_SUBTREE.
_lines: id = the machine's name (lowercase, CLI/config/slot names); label = what the operator sees (Chinese welcome); hint = one line of purpose for the decomposer and the humans; accept = "human" (default: a delivery waits for your 通过) or "auto" (deliveries on this line complete on report — the close gates still run, human-gated cards still wait).
_role: v0.22, optional per line: what the line IS. kind = implement (default) | review (reads, checks and judges only — its evidence is the review; the decomposer never sends it implementation cards). tools = write (default) | read-only (review defaults to read-only): the ONE part a machine enforces — the Claude seat's argv (no Edit, the work repo under an Edit deny), the codex seat's --sandbox read-only. charter = a .md relative to THIS board repo, inlined verbatim with its sha256 into every prompt on the line; it must sit inside gated_subtree (the source gate is what pins it — edit it and the line refuses to start until you bless again). Templates: examples/roles/*.md → copy to docs/roles/. seat = {runtime, model, effort} used as Agent1 the first time the line starts (a locked seat falls back loudly; the panel shows the drift). Evidence-based default (docs/方案-身份分配.md §1.3): put the OTHER family on the review line, keep the code-stage auto-reviewer on Claude.

lines.label: 架构
lines.hint: 审方案:只指出会在哪里崩、哪些假设没验证

_roles: single-seat roles. "review" enables the auto-reviewer (loops/reviewer_loop.py): it pre-runs each waiting card's verify_cmd, judges with a fresh model session per card (no Edit/Bash), and rules ONLY as resolved_by=auto via its own review_token. Opt-in: set ["review"] and restart.

runtimes.label: Codex CLI
runtimes._comment: reference seat (values measured on one deployment; an example, not an endorsement). Locked until release_env=1 AND cmd_env points at the CLI.

_language: Natural language for GENERATED card text (subject/description/acceptance). Omit or null = the generator mirrors the board's own language. Set it to write cards in yours, e.g. "English" / "日本語".
_handoff: Authorized local destinations for hand-applied ruling files. Only directories declared here are ever written; each target sets its own extension allowlist (omit = any) and admission name pattern (omit = four-digit serial, any extension). BOARD_HANDOFF_DIR alone synthesizes a single default target.
